definitions.scheduledService: Scheduled trips per day (the 12-week median), compared with the most scheduled in any 12-week stretch at least 3 years ago.
definitions.subwayService: Trips run per day (the 12-week median), compared with the busiest 4-week stretch at least 3 years ago.
definitions.frequencyTrain: Share of scheduled service hours, first trip to last, with a train at least every {{minutes}} minutes. Weekdays count five times as much as Saturday or Sunday.
definitions.frequencyBus: Share of scheduled service hours, first trip to last, with a bus at least every {{minutes}} minutes. Weekdays count five times as much as Saturday or Sunday.
definitions.frequencyAllBus: Share of scheduled service hours, first trip to last, with a bus at least every {{minutes}} minutes. Weekdays count five times as much as Saturday or Sunday. Each route counts by its riders.
definitions.speed: Median weekly average speed over 12 weeks, end to end including stops, compared with the fastest 4-week stretch at least 3 years ago.
definitions.slowZones: Average extra time per day that slow zones add to a trip, over the last 12 weeks.
definitions.subwayFleet: Age of the oldest cars still in regular service (at least 1% of cars over the last 4 weeks), counted from when that type was first built. Riders feel the oldest trains, not the average.
definitions.commuterRailFleet: Share of Commuter Rail service run with electric trains.
definitions.busFleet: Share of bus trips run by battery-electric or hybrid buses over the last 4 weeks.
